about_short_description.short_description: Zakher Marine International is a marine and offshore oil and gas industry as manning services, paining support vessels, salvage support etc.

product.name: Self-Propelled Jack-Up Barges
product.description: Mobile, self-elevating platforms providing stable offshore support for construction, maintenance, and accommodation in shallow to moderate water depths.

product.name: Dynamic Positioning Offshore Support Vessels (OSVs)
product.description: Vessels with dynamic positioning systems providing offshore support including supply, subsea construction, diving support, and towing services.

product.name: Offshore Renewable Energy Support Services
product.description: Services supporting offshore wind farm development including transport, installation, commissioning, operation, maintenance, and geotechnical investigation.

product.name: Expert Crew Placement
product.description: Provision of certified and experienced marine personnel for offshore operations to ensure safe and efficient project execution.

product.name: Supply Base and Equipment Services
product.description: Provision and maintenance of offshore equipment and resources to support energy sector operations, minimizing downtime and enhancing asset productivity.

product.name: Planning and Execution Services
product.description: Development and management of detailed project plans covering budget, timeline, quality, and safety to ensure timely offshore project delivery.
